kinds.description: Workload pods. Start here for any crashloop/OOM/backoff investigation.
In-cluster services. Check endpoints when a component is reachable from one pod but not another.
Operator-rendered or hand-applied configuration. Values redacted when they look like credentials.
Persistent storage claims. Pending PVCs are a common cause of stuck deploys.
Resolved backends behind a Service. Empty Endpoints explain 'connection refused' from callers.
Stateful workloads. Ready-replica drift is the canonical 'cluster is degraded' signal.
Deployment-owned ReplicaSets; useful only when diagnosing rollout churn.
Ingress routes for cluster-external traffic. Check when external clients can't reach a service.
